title: G. C. van Spaen (Düsseldorf) to M. van der Goes, 14 and 15 Jan 1808 (NA 2.01.08 inv. 281; DECODE R1941)

steps.what: Downloaded the four DECODE R1941 images with the saved cookie; P1/P2 are one annex page photographed twice.
Transcribed all 303 code groups (letter 228, annex 75) and the clear passages.
222 distinct of 303 groups, values 15-1339; trigram 602 441 373 x3; too sparse for a ciphertext-only attack on a 1,300+ entry code.
Searched DECODE key records 1780-1815 at Dutch holders; applied Croiset's 1803 book R1035 to the annex: word salad.
Searched Colenbrander, Gedenkstukken V (1806-1810) full text for Spaen, Voorstonden, Dusseldorp, Westphalen: letters not printed.

outcome.method_basis: A plain numerical code of 1,300+ entries, 303 groups; no DECODE key fits (R1035 ruled out) and nothing is in print.
